scope: 旺商聊群聊与后台管理职责对照。群管理身份不等于 AstrBot 超管；后台登录、逐群授权、原生角色和当前版本分别核验。允许入口不代表平台执行成功。

Wangshangliao group and WebUI responsibilities. Group managers are not AstrBot superadmins; dashboard sign-in, group grants, native roles and current revisions are checked separately. An available entry point does not prove upstream execution.

name: 原生接入
Native adapter
responsibility: 认证、群消息收发、业务 UID 与 NIM 身份映射
Authentication, group messaging and business UID / NIM mapping
boundary: 不按昵称或消息自报 UID 猜身份；未开通群仅保留受限开通入口
Never infer identity from names or message-claimed UIDs; unopened groups retain restricted activation only

name: 逐群鉴权
Group authorization
responsibility: 按机器人账号与群核验管理员、原生角色及版本
Verify managers, native roles and revisions by bot account and group
boundary: 撤权、离群、暂停和版本变化在提交前复查
Recheck revocation, departure, pause and revisions before submission

name: 群内固定命令
Deterministic group commands
responsibility: 整条消息识别、参数与群管理授权核验
Exact recognition, parameter validation and group-manager authorization
boundary: 固定动作不交给 AI 执行；编号及预览按群隔离
AI never executes fixed actions; selections and previews are group-scoped

name: 群聊与热群 AI
Group conversation AI
responsibility: 按群配置 @、自主接话、冷场话题、人格、模型与额度
Per-group mentions, autonomous replies, idle topics, personas, models and quotas
boundary: 默认关闭；承担人本人确认与预算门禁独立；未知结果不重试
Off by default; payer self-consent and budget gates remain independent; no uncertain retries

name: 群知识空间
Group knowledge
responsibility: 按机器人与群隔离资料和只读参考片段
Account/group-isolated material and read-only reference snippets
boundary: 不授予全局知识库权限，不执行资料中的指令
No global knowledge-base authority or execution of instructions in reference material

name: 广告与刷屏审核
Advertising and flood moderation
responsibility: 逐群关键词、组合规则、刷屏批次和媒体撤回
Per-group keywords, combinations, flood bursts and media recall
boundary: 先禁言再撤回刷屏批次；保护管理角色与有效豁免，不追罚历史消息
Mute before flood-burst recall; protect administrators and valid exemptions without retrospective sanctions

name: 处罚执行与回执
Sanctions and receipts
responsibility: 核验当前授权和原生角色，分别记录撤回、警告及禁言回执
Check current grants and native roles; record recall, warning and mute receipts separately
boundary: 自动审核不踢人；结果不明先核对，不重放
Automatic moderation never kicks; reconcile uncertain outcomes without replay

name: 黑白名单与发言统计
Member lists and speech
responsibility: 逐群名单、重入禁言、有效发言和历史查询
Group lists, rejoin mutes, valid speech and history queries
boundary: 黑名单优先；新增名单互斥，旧记录不自动转移；后台移除不解禁，群内解除分别反馈移出与解禁
Blacklist precedence; new entries are exclusive without migrating old records; WebUI removal never unmutes, while group removal reports removal and unmuting separately

name: 防袭群
Raid defense
responsibility: 新人观察、防护周期、剩余禁言恢复和独立回执
Newcomer observation, protection periods, remaining mute restoration and separate receipts
boundary: 默认关闭且须预览确认；不踢人，未知结果不重试
Off by default with preview confirmation; no kicks or uncertain retries

name: 群活动与邀请奖励
Group activities and invitations
responsibility: 后台配置活动、预约发布、群内报名、到时开奖及邀请归属记账
WebUI configuration, scheduled publication, group entries, deadline draws and invitation attribution
boundary: 开场冻结参数；发布须主动发送授权；不自动付款或重抽未知结果
Freeze settings at opening; require proactive-send authority; no automatic payments or uncertain rerolls

name: 定时发言与成员维护
Schedules and member maintenance
responsibility: 关键词回复、定时图文、每日禁言计划与名片任务
Keyword replies, scheduled media, daily mute schedules and card jobs
boundary: 版本化预览确认；暂停计划不解除当前禁言；未知不重试
Versioned preview confirmation; pausing schedules never unmutes; no uncertain retries

name: 插件管理与财务
Management and settlement
responsibility: 群规则、AI、套餐、活动、财务账本和运行审计
Group rules, AI, plans, activities, financial ledgers and operational audit
boundary: 后台登录和财务范围分别核验；保留历史账本，不自动转账
Check dashboard sign-in and financial scope separately; retain ledgers without automatic transfers

name: 服务总控与生命周期
Runtime and lifecycle
responsibility: 固定接口、组件并发、超时、熔断与逐群生命周期
Fixed APIs, component concurrency, deadlines, circuits and group lifecycle
boundary: 不提供任意调用代理；断线不删除业务数据；测试窗口不授予权限
No arbitrary-call proxy; disconnects never delete business data; test windows grant no authority

name: 普通群员
Group member
allowed: 已开放的排名、活动报名与本人邀请查询
Enabled rankings, activity entry and own invitation queries

name: 禁言专属成员
Mute-only delegate
scope: 服务端单独授权且列入专门汇报的机器人、群及UID
Explicit server grants intersected with the report bot, group and UID
allowed: 真实@一名非保护成员，明确禁言1至4320整分钟（最多3天）
Mute one real-mentioned unprotected member for 1..4320 explicit whole minutes (three days maximum)
denied: 踢人、解禁、名单、规则、财务及后台操作
Kicking, unmuting, lists, rules, finance and dashboard actions

name: 本群授权管理
Authorized group manager
denied: 其他群、后台总控及自动财务授权
Other groups, total control and automatic finance authority

name: 后台操作者
Dashboard operator
scope: 已登录的 bot 范围
allowed: 范围内群规则、AI、活动及运行设置
Scoped group rules, AI, activities and runtime settings
denied: 绕过原生角色、确认或预算
Bypassing native roles, confirmation or budgets

name: 网页结账员
Web settlement operator
denied: 自动转账或重写历史金额
Automatic transfers or historical amount rewrites

name: 禁言专属授权
Delegated member mute
rule: 仅单独授权的专门汇报成员可用，不由群管理身份继承；保护名单及已有禁言不覆盖
Only separately authorized report members; manager status never implies this grant, protected or already-muted targets are not overridden

name: 取消未提交操作
Cancel pending operation
rule: 只取消本人当前群未提交操作，不撤销已提交请求
Cancel only the caller's pending group operation, never a submitted request

name: 每日排名
Daily rankings
rule: 所有群员可查前20名，显示昵称及有效发言数，不显示UID、不分页，命令及回复自动撤回
Everyone can query the top twenty names and valid speech counts, without UIDs or pagination; commands and replies are recalled automatically

name: 抽奖报名与状态
Lottery entry and status
rule: 使用本期报名口令，按冻结参数开奖
Use the current entry phrase and frozen draw settings

name: 本人邀请
Own invitations
rule: 只查询本人，不授予改价或结账权
Own records only; no repricing or settlement authority

name: 成员解禁
Unmute member
rule: 提交前核验目标及原生管理权限
Verify target and native authority before submission

name: 手动移除成员
Manual member removal
rule: 管理员预览确认，保护群管理及机器人
Administrator preview confirmation; protect administrators and bots

name: 发布公告
Publish announcement
rule: 仅已授权群
Authorized group only

name: 群规则与名单
Group rules and lists
rule: 按群核权、核验目标及当前版本；黑名单处罚仍须禁言授权，时长在后台维护
Verify group authority, target and revision; blacklist sanctions require mute authority, with duration maintained in WebUI

name: 群聊 AI 状态
Group AI status
rule: 不绕过承担人确认、套餐或预算门禁
Never bypass payer consent, plans or budgets

name: 本群成员查询
Current group members
rule: 仅查询当前群，不扩展到其他群
Current group only; never extends to another group

name: 本群管理授权
Group manager grants
rule: 更改须当前原生群主，预览后本人确认
Changes require the current native owner and personal preview confirmation

name: 每日禁言计划
Daily mute schedules
rule: 版本化预览确认；暂停不解除当前禁言
Versioned preview confirmation; pausing never clears an existing mute

name: 群活动管理
Group activity management
rule: 开放状态及逐群角色另行核验；发布须主动发送授权，不自动付款
Check availability and group roles separately; publication requires proactive authority, never automatic payment

name: 关键词回复与定时图文
Keyword replies and scheduled media
rule: 写入须本人预览确认；图文资料在后台维护
Writes require personal preview confirmation; maintain media in WebUI

name: 群知识查询
Group knowledge queries
rule: 只读当前机器人和群；写入由已有后台权限者维护
Read only within the current bot and group; writes require existing dashboard authority

name: 跨群入口与开发门禁
Cross-group routing and test gates
rule: 不提供群内跨群切换；测试门禁仅后台维护，不授予管理权
No cross-group chat switching; WebUI-only test gates never grant authority

name: 普通手动禁言
General manual muting
rule: 普通单人禁言、全员禁言和解除全员禁言在旺商聊 App 操作；禁言专属授权独立，自动审核不受影响
Use the app for general member/global muting and global unmuting; delegated muting is independent and automatic moderation is unchanged

name: 封禁账号清理
Banned account cleanup
rule: 后台预览确认，仍须清理授权及当前原生管理权限
WebUI preview confirmation with saved cleanup grant and current native authority

name: 成员名片任务
Member card jobs
rule: 后台维护，保护群管理与机器人，仍须名片授权
WebUI only; protect administrators and bots; a saved rename grant remains required

name: 邀请记账与结账
Invitation ledger and settlement
rule: 独立后台财务范围，不由群管理身份自动授予，不自动转账
Independent WebUI financial scope; group managers gain no automatic authority; never transfers money

name: AI 管理执行
AI management execution
rule: AI 无权执行群管动作、变更授权或财务写入
AI cannot execute moderation, change grants or write financial records

name: 操作者身份
Caller identity
source: 可信 UID 与逐群管理授权
boundary: 原生角色不等于已开通或后台权限
Native roles do not imply activation or dashboard authority

name: 机器人动作
Bot actions
boundary: 保存授权不等于原生平台允许执行
A saved grant is not upstream permission

name: 主动发送
Proactive sending
source: 已保存的精确群目的地
boundary: 活动通知仍须当前授权
Activity notices still require current authorization

name: 后台登录
Dashboard sign-in
boundary: 插件 API 范围不能代替 bot 范围
Plugin API scope never replaces bot scope

name: 财务范围
Financial scope
source: 后台独立核验的财务授权
boundary: 普通群管理不自动获得结账权
Group management never automatically grants settlement authority

name: AI 预算
AI budgets
source: 套餐、承担人同意与供应商硬限额
Plans, payer consent and supplier hard limits
boundary: 额度豁免不豁免费用预算或并发限制
Quota exemption never bypasses cost budgets or concurrency limits
